content:
Overview

Raipur is a city in Chhattisgarh with a population of 1,200,000. The capital of Chhattisgarh, a rapidly growing industrial city known for its steel plants and mineral wealth. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
